goal: Answer this question in two natural sentences: when a test fails while you are fixing a project, what will you do next? This is a question only; do not create or modify files, run commands, or claim any tests have already run.

report.summary: I’ll inspect the failing test and its error output to identify the cause, then make the smallest targeted fix without weakening the test. I’ll rerun that test and any relevant checks, and report what passes and what still needs work.
